paragraphs.source_en: People know that they don't always get it right the first time they try something and that learning new things can be a bit scary. They don't want to embarrass themselves in front of peers or look stupid in front of their managers. units.source_en: ### Strengthen Resilience and Grit

paragraphs.source_en: It takes determination and strength to deal with the adversities of life and leadership. You can't let the setbacks get you down, or allow roadblocks to get in your way. You can't become overly discouraged when things don't go according to plan. You can't give up when resistance builds or the competition gets stiff. Nor can you let other tempting new projects divert your interest or distract your focus.
